facts.text: Audrey expressed appreciation for Andrew's offer to help find more places for dogs.

evidence.quote: Thanks! Appreciate the offer. Super nice to have friends who understand our love for our pets!

facts.text: Andrew acknowledged that people who understand the love for dogs are awesome and bring joy.

evidence.quote: Haha yeah! People who understand the love for dogs are awesome. They really bring so much joy!

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that she would like to take the dogs to the doggy daycare near Andrew.

evidence.quote: That looks fun! Where are you at? I would love to take the dogs there sometime soon.
This is the doggy daycare near me, it has a big indoor space for dogs to play.

facts.text: Audrey stated that animals bring joy and she cannot imagine life without them.

evidence.quote: Animals are great! They really bring so much joy. Can't imagine life without them!
